questions.label: 19(a)
questions.title: A balanced beam（平衡木板）
questions.promptHtml:

questions.answerHtml: 均匀木板的重力作用在中点，即距左端 2.0 m；支点距左端 1.5 m，所以重力作用线在支点右侧 0.50 m。

questions.label: 20(d)
questions.title: Newton's laws（牛顿定律）
questions.promptHtml:

questions.answerHtml:

questions.label: 23(a)
questions.title: Investigating Newton's second law（研究牛顿第二定律）
questions.promptHtml:
学生用小车、细线、滑轮、悬挂砝码、光电门和数据记录器研究 F=ma。
A student uses a trolley, string, pulley, hanging masses, light gates and a data logger to investigate F=ma.

研究 a 与 F 的关系时，应保持哪个量不变？怎样改变 F？
When investigating the relationship between a and F, what should be kept constant and how can F be changed?
questions.answerHtml:
保持小车和悬挂物组成的系统总质量不变；把砝码从小车转移到悬挂端来改变拉力。
Keep total system mass constant and transfer masses from the trolley to the hanger to change the force.

questions.answerHtml:
画 a 对 F 的图。支持 a∝F 的结果是最佳拟合直线经过原点。
Plot a against F; a straight best-fit line through the origin supports direct proportionality.
